text: For the one directing. According to “The Lilies.” Of the sons of Korah. A Maskil. A song of love. 1 My heart is stirred by a good word; I am telling my works, O king; my tongue [is] the pen of a swift scribe.
You are beautiful above the sons of man; favor is poured out from your lips; upon thus God has blessed you forever.
Gird your sword upon the thigh, O mighty one, [with] your majesty and splendor!
And [in] your splendor prosper! Ride forth upon a word of truth and gentleness [and] justice; and your right hand will teach you fearful [things].
Your arrows [are] sharp—the peoples fall under you—in the heart of the enemies of the king.
Your throne, O God, [is] forever and ever; a scepter of uprightness [is] the scepter of your kingdom.
You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness; upon thus, God, your God has anointed you with the oil of joy above your companions.
All your garments [are] with myrrh and aloes [and] cassia; from the palaces of ivory, the harps have made you glad.
Daughters of kings [are] among your precious ones; the queen stands at your right hand, in gold of Ophir.
Hear, O daughter, and see; and incline your ear, and forget your people and the house of your father.
For the king himself desires your beauty, because he [is] your lord—and bow to him—
and the daughter of Tyre, with a gift; the rich among the people, will seek your face.
All glorious [is] the daughter of the king inside; her clothing [is] with weavings of gold.
In various colors she is brought to the king; the virgins following her, companions of hers, shall be brought to you.
They are brought along with joy and rejoicing; they shall come into the palace of the king.
In place of your fathers shall be your sons, whom you shall make to [be] princes in all the earth.
I will cause your name to be remembered through all generations; upon thus the people will praise you forever and ever.
